date_selection_status: No independent date list is frozen or acquired
purpose: Independent catch-event probability diagnosis; not a G2 pass or a journey-gain experiment

date_rule.selection: After checking fitting, model selection, replay and prior research exposure, select the chronologically first 14 as-yet-unseen service dates with a valid static service feed, actual endpoint archive and predecision publication archive. Freeze the exact dates from source metadata before reading target values. The 35 listed dates are excluded; later dates are not automatically independent.
date_rule.availability: Record every considered date and missing source. Once dates are frozen, missing endpoints/messages and unavailable days remain reported; no outcome-based replacement or extension.

fixed.model: V41 physical law and working policies, including the current V34 physical fit and V35 emission fit; no target-day refitting
fixed.menu: decision_gap_v1 public candidate closure; unchanged ride-depth, pickup/dropoff, absorption and observation rules
fixed.population: Use the V34 public structural root recipe and the P2 first-onboard opportunity enumeration on every selected date before event labels. Retain roots with unavailable initial prefixes as unresolved rather than silently discarding them.
fixed.joins: Existing service date/operator/vehicle/stop/event/scheduled-minute join. Preserve REAL, CANCELED, forecast, missing and ambiguous identities separately.
fixed.information: Each prediction uses only messages received by its actual decision clock. Missing or aged numeric forecasts retain their prespecified groups.
fixed.mct: Unchanged GTFS station maximum values; separate platform-pair provenance status, no favorable buffer adjustment

missingness.events: Retain all four catch partitions, cancellations, absent downstream opportunities and unknown labels. Use the existing possible-partition bounds for unavailable labels.
missingness.probabilities: Unsupported same-chain or missing-history probabilities remain unresolved and count in the denominator; complete-case scores are supplemental.

inference.unit: Operational incidents nested within service dates. Group rows sharing an incoming or outgoing named trip on a date; preserve exact duplicate causal event counts separately.
inference.summaries: Per partition, report incident- and day-level predicted probability, observed indicator bounds and their difference; also the four-class Brier score or its min/max over possible labels. Report all prespecified forecast/MCT/downstream-opportunity groups.
inference.uncertainty: Do not treat overlapping roots or catch windows as iid. Report all daily estimates and resample whole dates, retaining incidents intact, for descriptive 95% uncertainty; sparse groups and missing dates remain unresolved.
inference.decision: No numeric calibration-pass or practical-effect threshold has been justified in this stage. Probability diagnostics cannot authorize a structural algorithm or establish G2/G3. A confirmation claim requires its acceptance rule to be fixed before the independent values are opened.

groups.downstream_opportunities: count on the declared same-trip path

limitations: Untouched actual endpoints and predecision messages have not been located and verified.
Concrete platform-pair transfer identity is absent from the current rail replay metadata.
